Cold stress experiments were performed by growing  $ \Delta\text{crt}E $,  $ \Delta\text{crt}X $, and  $ \Delta\text{crt}Y $ in LB and M9 medium at  $ 10^{\circ}\text{C} $ (for results in M9, see Fig. 1B).
